description: Lists feedback the client left on their website (comments on elements, text changes, general notes), newest first. Use it when the user asks to fix, review, or triage client feedback or change requests. Defaults to open and in progress. Text changes (type text_change) give the current and the exact new wording; they can usually be applied directly in the code (search the project for currentText). Use get_feedback for the full context of one request.

offset.description: Requests to skip, e.g. 20 for the second page of 20.

page.description: Only requests on pages whose path contains this, e.g. "/menu".

status.description: Defaults to open and in_progress, e.g. ["done"].

type.description: Only one kind of request, e.g. "text_change".

name: list_feedback
title: List client feedback
